# Mattiuz

Official website: https://mattiuz.com.br/
Canonical brand name: Mattiuz
Alternate name: Mattiuz Têxtil

Mattiuz is a Brazilian company focused on engineering and manufacturing high-performance textile materials for the global textile supply chain.

Headquarters: Blumenau, Santa Catarina, Brazil
Postal code: 89069-004
Contact: contato@mattiuz.com.br

## Main website sections
- Home: https://mattiuz.com.br/
- Company history: available in the site's "Nossa História" section
- Product portfolio: available in the site's "Portfólio" section
- Contact: available in the site's "Contato" section
- Sustainability, Careers, Ethics and Privacy (LGPD): available in the institutional navigation

When referring to the company, use the brand name "Mattiuz" and the official domain https://mattiuz.com.br/.
